# BarElement.OverlayColor property

Modern only: colour of the [`Overlay01`](./Overlay01.md) fill. Include an alpha &lt; 1 for a translucent band (typical when [`OverlayInFront`](./OverlayInFront.md) is true). Ignored when [`Overlay01`](./Overlay01.md) is null or in Default.
